text.agent.mjs: runs one headless claude call with what is left of the cost cap and turns a spend over the cap or a budget stop into a cap failure
text.areas-checks.mjs: Judge a finished areas fixture by scripts only: sources untouched, map settled, the tree passes the areas check, and a new feature is placed or left under To assign with the tree intact
text.areas-fake.mjs: Write the good or broken answer a model would give for the areas fixture: a passing tree, or a feature placed in an area or left out when the tree is full
text.areas-fixtures.mjs: Build the neutral 12-feature shop with a settled map of 121 records and a five-area, seven-area or layer-named tree
text.areas-slices.mjs: Define the areas slices of lantern-vocabulary: a free fixture check, then paid agent steps that write the tree and place a new feature with and without room
text.extra-skills.mjs: Check offline that each role's required-skills list is its fixed skills plus its slot once each, that the handover gate is green with full reads and no extra line in the brief and red when a slot skill is not read in full, and that the delegate skill files run the list command, name no fixed skill, keep the skill linker to the brief's Conventions block
text.fake-agent.mjs: stands in for the claude binary offline: performs the skill's map, re-map, retag or delegate steps with its scripts, following the project's stored PR delivery, and reports a cost
text.fake-agent.mjs gotcha: stops with error_max_budget_usd before touching anything when its cost passes the budget, like claude does
text.fixtures.mjs: builds the tiny fixture project, writes a settled map deterministically and runs the setup and sync scripts against it
text.lantern-areas-find.mjs: List every file of a given name under a directory, searching subdirectories, in sorted order
text.lantern-areas-checks.mjs: Judge a finished lantern-areas fixture by scripts only: sources and records untouched, map settled and strict, the tree passes the areas check and the blind lookup, or the flat view is said in the report
text.lantern-areas-fake.mjs: Write the good or broken answer a model would give for each lantern-areas project: the right tree with its lookup files, a layered or misleading one, or an eighth area
text.lantern-areas-fixtures.mjs: Build the five neutral lantern-areas projects (good, trap, small, old-map retag, overflow) with settled maps and deterministic sources
text.lantern-areas-reader.mjs: Stand in for the blind readers offline: answer each lookup packet with the area whose purpose shares the most words with the feature text
text.lantern-areas-slices.mjs: Define the lantern-areas check: five free fixture slices that prove each judge can fail, then five isolated paid agent slices
text.lantern-areas-specs.mjs: Hold the data of the shop and studio projects: features with their texts, the right tree, the misleading and layered trees, and the coupling lines
text.prompts.mjs: holds the prompts the paid slices send: map the project, re-map after a change, and retag an untidy map, write the areas tree, and add a feature to it
text.report.mjs: builds the per-skill report from the slice outcomes and renders PASS or FAIL per slice with the spend and exit code
text.run.mjs: command entry that checks one skill in slices, offline by default, takes the delegate delivery to test, prints the plan with the cost cap before any paid run and the macro-eval tables
text.run.mjs gotcha: --live spends real usage: only the offline default and --dry-run are free
text.slices.mjs: defines the cheap slices of lantern-setup, lantern-sync, lantern-delegate and lantern-vocabulary: free checks first, then paid agent steps judged by the skill's own gates; the delegate run checks the delivery and the account taken from the fake Lantern socket
text.vocab-checks.mjs: judges a finished fixture by scripts only: strict validation, shared feature ids across clients, canonical outside systems, kept records and macro-eval before and after
text.vocab-fake.mjs: writes the good or broken answer a model would give for each vocabulary fixture, using the setup and retag scripts
text.vocab-fixtures.mjs: builds the three neutral vocabulary projects: two clients of one capability, a project with no channels, and one with a prebuilt untidy map
text.vocab-slices.mjs: defines the lantern-vocabulary check: three free fixture slices that prove the judge can fail, then three isolated paid agent slices, plus the areas slices
